pages.text: Oak, birch, spruce, jungle, acacia and dark oak barrels work the same way.

pages.title: Age a Fermented Brew
pages.text: Transfer fermented liquid into a barrel and check the style as it matures. Draw it into an empty vessel at the tap or use the menu slots. Red grape wine becomes vinegar at stage 16.

pages.title: Order Matters
pages.text: Decide whether to distill before aging. The distillery requires fermented brew with zero maturation. Age a distilled brew afterward when its style calls for it.
